_about: Exceptions to the design lint (tools/agents/design-lint.mjs, D-533), each with its reason: none is silent. Entries { file, rule, what, reason }: `rule` is one of token-colour, colour, radius, space, copied, text-size or `*`; `what` matches the hit's declaration (`color: #ff8a8a`) or selector, `*` matching any run of characters. An entry that no longer hits fails design-lint.test.mjs as stale, so remove it when the stylesheet changes. The human-readable side is docs/DESIGN.md §4.

entries.reason: the chat bubble's tail: a 4 px corner is a shape (where the bubble points), not a size on the corner scale
reserves the install bubble's height under the page while it floats (D-232): the size of another element, not rhythm
room for the install bubble's ✕ (44 px, absolutely positioned) beside the text: the size of another element, not rhythm
room for the install bubble's ✕ beside the button from 480 px: the size of another element, not rhythm
the podium step (.escalon): flat 4 px feet so the three steps read as one podium; a shape, not a size on the scale
the speech bubble's tail (.cs-globo), the same 4 px tail as base.css's chat bubble; a shape, not a size on the scale
The word's letters on the board (`.word .ch`): the game's own size, between the title steps and the text steps, chosen so a long word fits at 320 px (C-8).
The word's letters when the word is long (`.word.long .ch`) and the theme card's emoji: the board's own sizes.
The word's letters on a short screen (`.word .ch` under 780 px tall): the board's own size.
The revealed word on the verdict's card (`.verdict .word-big span`): the board's own size.
The deck card's emoji (`.theme-card .em`), the same card and size as Ahorcado's theme card: a board's own size, between the text steps and the title steps; the card is a candidate shell component.
The solo score (`.puntos b`): a figure the player reads at a glance, the board's own size above the text steps (D-30: figures in --font-num).

The hero's emoji at two moments the shell's 4.2 rem does not fit (C-8): the cover's icon on a short phone (under 600 px tall), so the Número / Palabra toggle and the first mode stay above the fold at 320×568 (landing-fold.mjs), and the solo result's trophy, so the score, the card and the final buttons fit without scrolling. Between the shell's size and the text steps: a hero's own size, not a text step.
The kept-die tag (`.dado-btn .tag`, "Guardado") under each of five dice: the board's own size, so the word fits under a 50 px die at 320 px (C-8); the smallest text step overflows it.
The rivals' dice drawn as glyphs (`.rivals .rival .d`): five of them must fit in the rival card's 74 px, under the smallest text step; a board's own size.
The bid's figure (`.amount-n`): a number the table reads from across the phone, the board's own size above the text steps (D-30: figures in --font-num).
The playing card's rank (`.pcard .r`): the card's own size, sized with the card (38 to 58 px wide, five in a row at 320 px, C-8), not a text step.
The playing card's suit (`.pcard .s`): the card's own size, under its rank.
The tiny card's rank (`.pcard--xs .r`, 28 px wide, in the hand's review): the card's own size.
The tiny card's suit (`.pcard--xs .s`): the card's own size, under its rank.
The board's cell (`.cell`, and the flash over it): a tile of a 10×10 grid, not a card; 4 px keeps the sea reading as one surface with hairline gaps.
The same tile on the small board (`.grid-wrap.small .cell`, the fleets of the result) and the chip's ship squares (`.barco-tira .barco`): a 12 to 19 px tile takes a 2 px corner.

The small board's cell glyph and its labels (`.grid-wrap.small .cell`, `.fleets .grid .lbl`): the board's own size, under the smallest text step, so a 220 px board still shows its 💥 and its row numbers.

The chameleon's reveal on the secret card (`.big-lizard`): the one card without a word, so the lizard is bigger than the cover's icon (4.2 rem) and whoever holds the phone knows at once; a hero's own size, not a text step.

The Cuenta Cuentos countdown (`.helper .timer`): a figure the table reads at a glance while someone talks, the board's own size above the text steps (D-30: figures in --font-num); the same size as Línea de Tiempo's solo score.

The final screen's crown (`.finale .crown-big`): smaller than the result hero's 4.2 rem so the three buttons are seen without scrolling with six players on an 812 px phone, in every language (C-8, measured); a hero's own size, not a text step.

The clinking glasses on the turn handoff (`.handoff .pase .cheers`): smaller than the shell's 5.5 rem because the result and the pass share one screen and with six drinkers the button fell off a small phone (C-9, C-8); a hero's own size.
The cover's jumping 🥷 beside the title (`.titulo-ninja .logo`): an emoji drawn to the title's height, a hero's own size above the text steps.
The night's fade at the canvas' edges (`.lienzo-ninja, .demo-ninja`): black in a mask is opacity, not a colour the player sees.
The cover's swaying 🔐 (`.portada .icono`): a hero's emoji, the shell's hero size (4.2 rem) rounded down so the cover's demo stays in view at 320 px; above the text steps.
The result's trophy (`.resultado .trofeo`): a hero's emoji above the text steps, under the shell's 4.2 rem so the opened code and the form fit.
The opened code on the result (`.resultado .codigo`): a figure the player reads at a glance, spaced 0.3 em, the board's own size above the text steps (D-30: figures in --font-num).
The cover's padlock beside the title (`.titulo-clave.grande .candado`): an emoji drawn to the title's height, a hero's own size above the text steps.
The title's bomb emoji (`.titulo-ne .bomba`), beating beside the game's title: an emoji sized to sit with the display title, between the text steps and the title steps.

The cover demo's «¡Limpio!» (`.demo-rotulo`): it fills the 260 × 56 px space the two cleared rows leave, in its place (the board's own size, fixed so it does not move with the viewport like a .display step).

The cover's 🐤 beside the title (`.titulo-aletazo .logo`), and the title itself on a short phone (under 640 px tall): sized together so the card keeps 🐤 Jugar in view at 320×568 (U-39); a .display step at 320 px is smaller than the title the cover is built around.
The cover's 🗼 beside the .display--lg title (`.titulo-torre .logo`): an emoji sized to sit with the title, between the text steps and the title steps (as Aletazo's 🐤).
The game's last word over the tower (`.aviso-torre.final`): one step above the streak's «Perfect ×n» (2 rem) so the end reads as the end, fixed over the canvas like the score above it.
The cover's swaying train beside the title (`.titulo-tv .tren`): an emoji drawn to the title's height, a hero's own size above the text steps, like the shell's hero icon.
Each plank of the wood left (`.tv-tablones span`, 14 px tall and a few px wide): a plank's nearly square corner is its shape; the smallest corner step (8 px) turns the planks into pills.
The opaque stop of the masks that melt the tower into the night and the end's strip at its edges: a mask reads only the alpha, black is not a colour the player sees.
«Perfecto ×n» flashing over the tower (`.sk-aviso.brilla`): a board's own message, read over the moving tower, between the text steps and the title steps.
«Fin del juego» over the fallen tower (`.sk-aviso.final`): a board's own message, as large as the title's top step at 390 px.
The pause's title over the tower (`.sk-pausa .display`): the board's own message, the floor of .display--xl fixed so it does not grow over the tower on a wide screen.
The end's strip (`.sk-juego.gira .sk-fin`) rises 110 px over the tower so «Continue» floats on it: the overlap is the tower's, not rhythm.
The end's strip keeps 44 px above «Continue» for its 40 px melting top (the mask's ramp): the size of the fade, not rhythm.
The opaque stops of the masks that melt the night into the page on every side: a mask reads only the alpha, black is not a colour the player sees.
The pause's title over the night (`.sn-pausa .display`): the board's own message, the floor of .display--xl fixed so it does not grow over the run on a wide screen (as Babel's).
The demo's «¡Listo!» stamped over the 180 px board that solves itself (`.lt-demo-rotulo`): a board's own message, sized to that board, between the text steps and the title steps.

A plank of the wood left (`.tv-tablones span`), 14 px tall and a few px wide when the stage gives many meters: an 8 px corner would turn each plank into a pill; a shape of the board, not a size on the corner scale.
The clue's word (`.ag-pista .ag-palabra`): the one word the whole table reads, the board's own size between the text steps and the title steps (like Ahorcado's word).
Centres the 900 px sunburst (`.me-rayos`) on the screen: half the rays' own size, not rhythm.
The rays' radial fade (`.me-rayos`): a mask reads only the alpha, its black is opacity, not a colour.
Room above the podium's card for the medal hanging over it (`.me-p1…3 .me-tarjeta`): the medal's size, not rhythm.
Pulls the medal (`.me-medalla`, 177 px tall) up over the card's top edge: the medal's size, not rhythm.
The room for the smaller medal on a short phone (`.me-p1…3 .me-tarjeta`), so «Jugar» stays on screen: the medal's size, not rhythm.
Pulls the smaller medal (127 px tall) over the card on a short phone: the medal's size, not rhythm.
The kicker's sides when there is no medal (`.me-resto .me-kicker`): room for the 44 px ✕ in the card's corner; another element's size, not rhythm.
The place (`.me-lugar`, «#4»), the month's result: a figure read like a title (D-30), the size of the medal it stands in for.

The Colocar bar's fade (`.place-row`) into the shell's night, written as a fixed colour, not var(--bg1): Pintaminas' hard mode redeclares --bg1…3 on La Copa's body, and a token here would retint the fade; whether it should follow the page's night is the owner's call.
